details: The Federal Reserve raised its benchmark interest rate by 25 basis points, bringing the target range to 3.75%-4.00%. This marks the first rate hike since July 2023 and reflects policymakers' ongoing concerns about elevated inflation. While largely anticipated by financial markets, leading to a muted initial reaction in cryptocurrencies, sustained higher rates could tighten liquidity and borrowing conditions. This tightening may dampen future demand for risk assets such as cryptocurrencies.
title: US Fed Hikes Rates 25 BPS, Impact on Crypto Liquidity Eyed

details: The Digital Asset Market Clarity Act failed to advance in the US Senate, falling short of the 60 votes required for passage. This legislative setback effectively postpones the establishment of a clear and comprehensive regulatory framework for digital assets in the United States, indicating that market structure legislation is unlikely to pass this year. The news has already triggered significant outflows from spot Bitcoin ETFs, totaling $450 million, and negatively impacted regulation-sensitive altcoins like XRP and Stellar, signaling prolonged uncertainty for the cryptocurrency market.
title: US Senate Rejects CLARITY Act, Delays Crypto Regulatory Framework
